title: RecField: Embedding Recommendations into Spatial Movie Organization as Affordances for Serendipitous Encounters
abstract: arXiv:2611.34330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on serendipity-oriented recommender systems has focused on algorithms that recommend unexpected yet useful items. However, serendipity is increasingly viewed as a user experience shaped by both algorithmic outputs and system features. This study positions recommendations not as the primary goal users pursue but as an environmental affordance that creates opportunities for discovery during other activities. We propose RecField, a spatial movie organization interface where users freely arrange movies into collection zones. For each collection, RecField provides attribute-based recommendation lists labeled according to their recommendation perspectives. A between-subjects experiment ($N$ = 57) examined the effects of recommendations on discoveries made during a foreground task of creating and organizing personal movie profiles. translated_title: RecField：将推荐嵌入电影的空间化组织，作为促成意外发现的可供性
translated_abstract: 面向意外发现（serendipity）的推荐系统研究一直聚焦于推荐意外却有用物品的算法。然而，意外发现日益被视为一种由算法输出与系统特征共同塑造的用户体验。本研究将推荐定位为一种环境可供性——推荐并非用户主动追求的主要目标，而是在用户进行其他活动时创造发现机会。我们提出了RecField，一个空间化的电影组织界面，用户可以在其中将电影自由地排列为收藏区域。针对每个收藏集，RecField提供基于属性的推荐列表，并依据推荐视角加以标注。一项被试间实验（N = 57）考察了推荐对用户在创建和组织个人电影档案这一前台任务过程中所产生发现的影响。尽管推荐并未显著影响环境层面的感知意外性，但对……的评分（原文摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究提出RecField空间电影组织界面，将推荐系统作为环境可供性嵌入用户的电影收藏整理活动中，使用户在完成前台任务的过程中自然地产生意外发现。
en_tdlr: This study proposes RecField, a spatial movie organization interface that embeds recommendations as environmental affordances, enabling serendipitous discoveries while users engage in the foreground task of organizing their personal movie collections.
